PROBE AGENT-001 W2: ordinary operator reply -> human takeover -> widget reload -> distinct AI history author and visible Human responder; human message carries no AI label
PROBE AGENT-001 W3: existing brand/widget browser registration -> rendered disclosure and fetched-history assertions; no additional test registration
PROBE browser ACCESS-001: owner/admin load and save General, Appearance and Availability; collaborator/operator/custom-admin refused

Checkpoint: offline post-erase storage assertions passed

ok 1 - inbox finds every readable exact ticket reference prefix without leaking tenant or operator-scoped tickets
